_doc: Whitelisted evidence-check violations (tools/evidence_check.py; docs/RULES.md R-AUD-05), 2026-10-29. Each entry: the most violations allowed for one category and school, and why they cannot be fixed in this build. A count above max fails the check and holds the release. Lower the counts as the gaps are fixed; never raise one without a reason. 2026-10-29 (data-quality pass): counts lowered after the re-capture of the cited pages (R-STU-08); student-only quotes are their own categories (R-AUD-09). 2026-10-30 (R-AUD-10, docs/UNAVAILABLE.md): the unavailability ledger's categories unavailable_missing (a non-local lab paper without a ledger record), unavailable_stale (a record checked before the build or the copies count) and unavailable_incomplete (reason_code incomplete_check) use the same {max, why} entries per school.
